a health plan (its name only) or paying yourself
for a video visit: the state the patient will be in
join the list for a sooner time
after_time: anything the office should know to help, like a wheelchair or needing an interpreter
at a care home: only what the home's rules ask, like signing in at the front desk
secure_page_only: plan member ID, the plan holder and a photo of the plan card
the primary care doctor, where the plan needs a referral
health history: medicines, allergies, past skin cancer, pregnancy
photos of a spot, if the patient wants the clinician to see it first (optional; never by text or through the AI)
consent forms and the privacy notice
a parent's or guardian's consent for anyone under 18
intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, a spot's details, photos and results are never asked or typed in the AI chat or a text
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; cosmetic visits only for adults 18 or older

stop.words: swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, or trouble breathing (for example after a new medicine or a shot)
stop.say: This needs care now. Call 911. Don't wait for a skin visit.

stop.words: a fast-spreading rash with blisters, peeling skin or a high fever
stop.say: Please call 911 or go to the emergency room now.

stop.words: bleeding that won't stop after 20 minutes of firm pressure
stop.say: Call 911 or go to the emergency room now.

stop.words: swallowed a skin medicine, or too much of one
stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222, or 911 if they're not awake or not breathing.

go_on.words: a spot or wound that's red, hot and spreading, a rash near the eye, or a cosmetic area that turns white or very painful after filler
go_on.what: the safety steps first: go to urgent care today, or call the office's own line; the booking can go on after

go_on.words: a spot that changed, a rash, acne or itching with nothing else
go_on.what: matched to the office's own visit types; Rosie never says what a spot might be or how soon to be seen

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, medicines, consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; returning patients once a year, or when their health changes
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand; when the desk is closed, by the next business day
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (checked later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A referral from the primary care doctor
steps.when: before the visit, where the patient's plan needs one (the plans that do are set at sign-up)
steps.who: the patient asks that doctor's office; Rosie never contacts it; the desk marks it in
steps.goodFor: the visits and the end date the referral itself sets
steps.result: not in 2 business days before the visit: the patient picks on the secure page (ask the doctor again, pay for the visit, or a call from the desk); the text never says 'referral'

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay and cosmetic patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example office's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: A cosmetic consult before a first filler
steps.result: the injector OKs it, suggests another plan, or calls it off with a full refund

first_steps_and_forms.prep: new patients arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID and the plan card; for a skin check, come without nail polish or makeup so the whole skin can be checked; the office's own notes for the visit are on the secure page

staff.skills: dermatologists: every visit, biopsies, cosmetic injections; physician assistants and nurse practitioners: skin checks, problem visits, biopsies, and cosmetic injections where the state allows and the practice lists them; medical assistants and the front desk: no clinical OKs
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each dermatologist's, physician assistant's and nurse practitioner's own license, per state
staff.supervision: a physician assistant works with a supervising or collaborating physician as each state sets (a switch: the supervisor must be working, or reachable); a nurse practitioner works alone or with a physician, as the state sets
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs fees and same-day times; every price is on the list, so no quote waits for him
staff.stand_in: a physician assistant may stand in for a skin check or a problem visit, only with the patient's yes, while a supervisor who may supervise them is working (or reachable, where the state's switch allows); with no yes, nobody is moved: the time stays, and the desk calls; cosmetic visits only with another listed injector

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; cosmetic visits only for adults 18 or older
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

visit.check_in: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk; by video: the code read out at the start; at a home visit: the code at the exam room's door
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the clinician's notes, skin photos taken at the visit and results stay in the office's own medical record, never in a text
visit.changes_at_visit: a biopsy, or freezing a spot, is added only with the patient's yes after the clinician explains it; its self-pay price comes from the list, or the plan is billed; cosmetic units are agreed before any shot
visit.before_work: the clinician reads the health history and any photos the patient added, and checks for changes

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: each dermatologist (MD or DO), physician assistant and nurse practitioner who sees patients holds their own active license from the state where the patient is during the visit, video included
license.who: each person; the practice too where the state's form registers medical offices or a place of care away from the office
license.ask: each clinician's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the practice's registration, and any permit for care away from the office, from the owner
license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form or a care home asks for it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, a referral, the reason, a spot, photos or results; flow A's texts drop the clinician's name; at the patient's home or care home the clinician's name stays, for the door check
